nodes.html: Situated where the North and South Esk rivers meet to form the Tamar River, Launceston is one of Australia's oldest and most picturesque inland cities. Walking through Quadrant Mall, City Park or the Seaport precinct reveals rich Victorian architecture, heritage gardens and vibrant regional dining where agricultural producers, wine makers and local trade owners meet.
